unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented multi-agent automatic generation of instance-specific evaluation rubrics for LLM-judge evaluation of medical responses
Using generated rubrics to guide iterative refinement of medical LLM responses

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates a retrieval-augmented multi-agent rubric generation framework designed to safeguard medical LLM outputs via rigorous factual evaluation and response refinement on standard benchmarks (HealthBench and LLMEval-Med).

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented automated rubric evaluation and response refinement
